This feels like sitting on a cozy riverside porch deep in the woods, listening to the gentle crackle of a campfire while the water flows nearby. The piano blends beautifully with the nature sounds, creating such a peaceful atmosphere. Perfect for relaxing, unwinding after a long day, and drifting into a deep, restful sleep.
“Listening with headphones at night hits differently. Feels like a quiet road trip through the desert 🚐🌙”

Beautiful visuals and lovely music, but the raging outdoor fireplace feels a bit out of place for a lush summer forest scene—it makes the setting feel a bit too hot rather than cozy! The two birds jumping up and down on the porch on a continuous loop are also a bit distracting. The scene would feel much more natural and relaxing if the birds came and went occasionally, or if the porch was left empty but peaceful. Beautiful choice of music, though!
